docker_compose_file:
services:
  web:
    image: nginx:1.27@sha256:abababababababababababababababababababababababababababababababab
    ports:
    - 443:80
    environment:
      MODE: production
      LOG_LEVEL: info
    depends_on:
      db:
        condition: service_started
      cache:
        condition: service_started
      alpha-runtime:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
    - alpha-secrets-web:/run/secrets:ro
  db:
    image: postgres@sha256:cdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcdcd
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD_FILE: /run/secrets/db_password
    volumes:
    - pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    - alpha-secrets-db:/run/secrets:ro
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD-SHELL
      - pg_isready -U postgres
      interval: 10s
    depends_on:
      alpha-runtime:
        condition: service_healthy
    restart: always
  cache:
    image: redis@sha256:efefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefefef
    command:
    - redis-server
    - --save
    - ''
    user: '999'
    volumes:
    - type: volume
      source: cachedata
      target: /data
    restart: always
  alpha-runtime:
    image: ghcr.io/alphacompute/alpha-runtime@sha256:7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d7d
    environment:
      ALPHACOMPUTE_KMS_CA_SPKI_SHA256: sha256:c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1c1
      ALPHACOMPUTE_KMS_REVISIONS: sha256:e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1e1,sha256:e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2e2
      ALPHACOMPUTE_KMS_ENDPOINTS: ${ALPHACOMPUTE_KMS_ENDPOINTS}
      ALPHACOMPUTE_SECRETS: '{"db":["db_password"],"web":["db_password","session_key"]}'
    restart: always
    volumes:
    - /var/run/dstack.sock:/var/run/dstack.sock
    - /run/log/dstack:/run/log/dstack:ro
    - /sys/firmware/acpi/tables/data/CCEL:/ccel:ro
    - alpha-run:/run/alpha
    - alpha-secrets-db:/run/alpha-secrets/db
    - alpha-secrets-web:/run/alpha-secrets/web
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - /alpha-runtime
      - healthcheck
      interval: 5s
      start_period: 24h
volumes:
  pgdata: {}
  cachedata: {}
  alpha-run: {}
  alpha-secrets-db:
    driver_opts:
      type: tmpfs
      device: tmpfs
  alpha-secrets-web:
    driver_opts:
      type: tmpfs
      device: tmpfs
name: 01994b3e-5c8a-7d3e-9a1b-2c3d4e5f6a7b
pre_launch_script: until c=$(docker ps -aq) && [ -z "$c" ]; do docker rm -f $c >/dev/null || { poweroff; exit 1; }; done
